emptyPlans.title: No membership plans
emptyPlans.description: Create a plan so players can subscribe (e.g. N sessions per day for a fixed monthly price).

profitability.heading: Membership profitability
profitability.description: Compares what each member pays against the value of court time they used this month (at regular price, as if they had no membership). A high ratio means the plan is giving away more value than it charges for.
profitability.aboveSub: {above} of {total} play more than they pay for
profitability.belowSub: {below} of {total} pay more than they play
profitability.netNegative: The club is giving away {amount} more in court time than it charges in subscriptions this month.
profitability.netPositive: The subscription covers {amount} more than members used in court time this month.
profitability.memberSummary: {plan} · {sessions, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} this month · {value} in court value vs. {price} paid

noData.label: No data
noData.hint: Free or unpriced plan — not applicable.

veryBelow.label: 🔴 Well below value
veryBelow.hint: Using much more court value than they pay for. Consider raising the price or lowering included sessions/day.

atLimit.label: 🟡 At the limit
atLimit.hint: Getting slightly more value than they pay for.

balanced.label: 🟢 Balanced
balanced.hint: Healthy usage relative to the plan price.

underused.label: 🔵 Underused
underused.hint: Paying more than they play — risk of cancelling if they don't find value in it.

planModal.extraSessionPriceHint: If the member plays more times than included that day, this amount is charged per extra session. Leave it at 0 to charge the normal court price.
